correctness.rationale: For w=0^a1 0^b1 0^c1 0^d, previous-occurrence DP yields F=(a+2)(b+2)(c+2)(d+2)-(a+2)(b+2)-(a+2)(d+2)-(c+2)(d+2). Independent symbolic subtraction reproduced four exactly stated pair-transfer polynomials. Opposite-gap smoothing and transfer boundary signs reduce every global maximum to the balanced gap candidates. Parity-class excess polynomials are strictly positive, giving all four period-4 formulas and exact reversal-paired optimizers including t=0 endpoints. Independent exhaustive gap-quadruple enumeration for all 0<=m<=40 (135,751 tuples) reproduced formulas and equality lists. Infinite m follows the symbolic inequalities, not this bounded census.

originality.rationale: Flaxman–Harrow–Sorkin 2004 unrestricted alphabet/length optimum is Fibonacci growth and has alternating optimizer, generally outside fixed weight 3. Liron–Langberg 2012 deletion-channel extremals constrain runs / fixed deletion length, not the all-length distinct-subsequence union under exactly three ones. The gap-quartic constrained optimum and full equality classification are not logically implied; a specialized Parikh-vector extremal earlier theorem remains a plausible priority risk.
residual_risks: A fixed-composition subsequence extremum could be implicit in specialist deletion-channel literature.
The theorem concerns all lengths together; no claim that each fixed-length deletion sphere is simultaneously extremized.
